summary: Reviewed instagram.service.spec.ts diff: new assertion targets the correct call (disconnectProvider makes exactly one fetch call, the /me/permissions DELETE, so find()! is safe and non-null). resilientFetch always spreads init and adds signal:controller.signal before calling global fetch, so reverting this.fetch()->fetch() in disconnectProvider would leave deleteInit.signal undefined, making toBeInstanceOf(AbortSignal) throw an AssertionError -- the test would correctly fail on revert. Confirmed AbortSignal is a real global in this project's Node 24 jest testEnvironment:node setup, no ReferenceError risk. No other open Wave 10 blocking finding known.
